messages.author: 19a2bfae8a0a361b
messages.subject: Labeling question
parts:
If I have a data frame with a quoted column name, like `Some name`,
the quote marks (`) show up in the label as follows.

df <- data.frame(`test plot` = rep(1:3,4), x = 1:12, y = rnorm(12),
check.names = F)
qplot(x, y, colour = `test plot`, data = df)

I can change the labeling manually as follows, but I was hoping to
avoid that.

qplot(x, y, colour = `test plot`, data = df) +
scale_colour_discrete("test plot")

I think this behavior has changed from previous versions of ggplot2,
but I haven't tracked it down.
